photos.c: Derek Crookes receives the South London News Group Award from Mick Ledbury which was presented to Belgrave's walkers for'Outstanding Sports Achievements' earlier in the year. Also L. to R. are; Paul Blagg, Stephan Marshall,Paul Warburton, Carl Lawton, Ron Day, John Newnham, John Hall.
Above: John Hall, Eric Crutcher, Paul Warburton, Carl Lawton early in the Club 10M Champs.

Opposite page: When it came to the SCVAC T&F Final at Hendon on September 5th, Carl Lawton and Paul Warburton could not agree on who should be 'A' string for the 2k event. After a couple of laps Carl decided it should be him after all and sped away for the win and maximum points.
Bottom left to right: Easily the best looking of the walking crew (well, the photographer thinks so anyway) - Paul Warburton.
